name: Super-NaturalInstructions
description: A benchmark of 1,616 diverse NLP tasks with expert-written instructions covering 76 distinct task types, designed to evaluate NLP models' ability to generalize to unseen tasks when provided with task instructions.
reputation: A well-known instruction-following benchmark in the NLP community, widely used for evaluating zero-shot and few-shot generalization to unseen tasks.
notes: Enables rigorous benchmarking of cross-task generalization under instructions; includes a transformer model Tk-Instruct trained on the dataset.
